text:
Iyad Khan: hey everyone :wave: I’m Iyad — starting today on ML Infra. Quick intro: previously at a tiny startup building inference pipelines. PST based. Fun fact: I have a corgi rescue named Biscuit and a 300+ sticker repository of dog memes. Been excited to join Redwood!

Tanya (People Ops): welcome Iyad!!! :tada: buddy assigned is Alex G., he’ll DM you about the 1:1 and onboarding checklist. also we sent welcome swag — check your shipping email.

Alex G.: hey Iyad — hi! I’m your buddy. DMing now. For MDM/enrollment, hit up IT Support or follow the quickstart: <https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding|Onboarding Guide> -> Hardware & MDM.

Iyad Khan: thanks! can you confirm if we prefer company macs for infra folks? i asked for the M1 mac. also need access to Redwood Console and org repos.

IT Support: @Iyad Khan we provisioned an M1 laptop by default for infra teams unless you requested otherwise in offer form. MDM invite will come from jamf@redwood.com — check spam. Reply with your shipping tracking if anything looks off.

Morgan L.: hey — welcome! for Console access file a request in #help with this template: `team: ml-infra, resources: console-read+write, reason: onboarding access` — @jules will approve.

Jules N.: approving access once Alex confirms your team. Also, request VPN and dev LDAP access if you need on-prem clusters.

Iyad Khan: cool — Alex I’ll paste my SSH pub key in the #help ticket. one more Q: is there a recommended dotfiles / editor setup for infra folks?

Alex G.: we keep it pretty relaxed. most infra folks use VSCode + Remote-SSH with shared devcontainer for some services. I’ll drop my dotfiles link in DM. 

Infra Bot: New hire checklist updated: `hardware received: false`, `mdm_enrolled: false`, `console_access: pending` — reminder ping scheduled in 24h.

Tanya (People Ops): lunch tomorrow at 12:30 — remote folks get a $15 lunch stipend; check calendar invite. Also 1pm intro with engineering org.

Iyad Khan: woo thanks! also small request: my Biscuit might interrupt a few calls — alert now so you don’t judge my background noise :dog:

Morgan L.: perfect. We have a #pets channel — Biscuit must be verified by the sticker test :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: welcome again.

Alex G.: added you to ml-infra slack, repos, and pager rotation docs (read-only for now). I’ll walk you through local dev env tomorrow.

IT Support: Jamf invite resent. If you don’t see it in 30m, reply here and we’ll escalate.

Iyad Khan: got the jamf invite! enrolling now. thanks all :heart: looking forward to jumping in.

Alex G.: :thumbsup: see you at the intro!

Tanya (People Ops): official welcome from People Ops again — so glad you’re here.

Jules N.: adding a note to the Console permissions ticket: approve on receipt once Alex confirms.

Iyad Khan: last tiny thing — where do we post quick evals/prompt tests for Redwood Optimize? someone point me to the eval harness?

Morgan L.: put those in the repo `redwood/evals` and tag @research or @eng-ml depending on scope. There’s a README with examples.

Iyad Khan: perfect, cheers everyone!

Infra Bot: Reminder set for 24h: follow up on MDM enrollment and hardware delivery.

Alex G.: night team, welcome again :party_parrot:
